```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set Environment and load packages
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 2500)

if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(ggplot2,
               dplyr,
               magrittr,
               tidyr,
               plotrix,
               gmodels,
               foreign,
               ggcorrplot,
               Hmisc,
               car,
               psych,
               forcats,
               plotly,
               data.table,
               readxl,
               SnowballC,
               wordcloud,
               tm,
               ggdark)

# Set your own wd here
setwd("")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Processed data
load("./Exploratory pilot cleaned and recoded")

# Free response codes
ra_codes <- read_excel("./DC pilot free response codes.xlsx", sheet = "Combined")

# Merge RA codes in
cleaned$ResponseId <- as.character(cleaned$ResponseId)

ra_codes$Final_audience <- as.character(ra_codes$Final_audience)
ra_codes$Final_why <- as.character(ra_codes$Final_why)
ra_codes$Final_selfdet <- as.character(ra_codes$Final_selfdet)
ra_codes$Final_otherdet <- as.character(ra_codes$Final_otherdet)

cleaned %<>% left_join(ra_codes, by = "ResponseId")
```

## Behaviors

```{r behaviors, echo = FALSE}

DT::datatable(cleaned %>%

        mutate_all(as.character) %>%
        pivot_longer(Other_behaviors_1:Other_behaviors_10,
```

## Coded responses

```{r coded, echo = FALSE}
# find audience count lengths
never <- length(grep("0", cleaned$Final_audience))
family <- length(grep("1", cleaned$Final_audience))
friends <- length(grep("2", cleaned$Final_audience))
romantic_partners <- length(grep("3", cleaned$Final_audience))
ac_prof <- length(grep("4", cleaned$Final_audience))
strangers <- length(grep("5", cleaned$Final_audience))
other <- length(grep("6", cleaned$Final_audience))

# create df from audience counts
audience_df <- data.frame(c("never", "family", "friends", "romantic_partners", "ac_prof", "strangers", "other"), c(never, family, friends,
                      romantic_partners, ac_prof, strangers, other)) %>%
           rename(audience = c..never....family....friends....romantic_partners....ac_prof...,
                  count = c.never..family..friends..romantic_partners..ac_prof..strangers..) %>%
           mutate(audience = fct_reorder(audience, count))

ggplot(audience_df, aes(x = audience, y = count, fill = audience)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -.25) +
  labs(title = "Absolute counts of audiences that participants concealed from", subtitle = "Some ps listed more than one audience, so the sum across bars is greater than N")

# Motivation breakdown
self <- length(grep("1", cleaned$Final_why))
other_ppl <- length(grep("2", cleaned$Final_why))
na_motive <- length(grep("3", cleaned$Final_why))

motiv_df <- data.frame(c("self motive", "other motive", "not really a motive"), c(self, other_ppl, na_motive)) %>%
            rename(motive = c..self.motive....other.motive....not.really.a.motive.., count = c.self..other_ppl..na_motive.) %>%
            mutate(motive = fct_reorder(motive, count))

ggplot(motiv_df, aes(x = motive, y = count, fill = motive)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -.25) +
  labs(title = "Absolute counts of motivation for concealing, split by self/other", subtitle = "Some ps listed both self and other motives, so the sum across bars is greater than N")

```
